items.title: Safety

items:
Top Reasons to Book Grand Pearl:

* Private Beach Access Approx. 0.6 Miles Away
* Seasonal Tram to Private Beach Access (March-October)
* Lagoon-Style Community Pool
* Bikes Included In The Garage
* Dog Friendly Home (Fees and Restrictions Apply)
* Rooftop Terrace – Covered Lounge, Firepit, Summer Kitchen
* 3rd Floor Game Room With Arcades + Foosball Table
* Dual Laundry Rooms
* Built-In Natural Gas Grill
* Professionally Managed

Grand Pearl is a stunning 6-bedroom, 5 full-bathroom, and 3 half-bathroom luxury retreat that comfortably accommodates up to 18 guests in the highly sought-after Seacrest Beach community along 30A. Known for its refined design, expansive layout, and exceptional rooftop living spaces, this spacious home offers a sophisticated yet inviting setting just minutes from the Gulf.

The main living areas are thoughtfully positioned on the second floor, where an open-concept layout seamlessly connects the kitchen, dining, and living spaces in a bright and beautifully appointed setting designed for gathering. Each king bedroom features a private bathroom, complemented by a spacious bunk suite that provides flexible accommodations for larger groups. On the third floor, a dedicated game room with arcade games and a foosball table creates a lively retreat apart from the main living area, offering room for everyone to spread out comfortably.

The rooftop terrace is the true highlight of the home, offering a rare blend of covered and open-air living designed for gathering above it all. From sunset dinners to relaxed evenings by the firepit, this elevated space creates an atmosphere that feels both inviting and memorable. Guests enjoy access to Seacrest Beach’s renowned 12,000 square-foot lagoon-style community pool and private Seacrest Beach Access, only about a 10-minute walk away. There is also a seasonal tram operating March through October, providing convenient transportation to and from the beach. Ideally situated between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, you’re minutes from local favorites like Pescado Rooftop, George’s at Alys Beach, Cowgirl Kitchen, and the shops and dining at 30Avenue. With its premier setting and standout rooftop design, Grand Pearl delivers a polished and unforgettable 30A escape.

Home Layout and Bedroom Details:

1st Floor:

Second Living Area: The second living area is the first space you enter when you walk in the front door. The leather sectional couch seats 6 people. There is also a wet bar in this space with a wine cooler and a sink.

Bedroom + Bathroom #1: To the left of the living room is Bedroom #1. It includes a king-sized bed, 2 nightstands, a dresser, and a flat-screen TV. It has a private bathroom with a double sink vanity and a stand-up shower.

Bedroom + Bathroom #2: To the right of the living room is Bedroom #2. It includes a king-sized bed, 2 nightstands, a dresser, and a flat-screen TV. It also has a private bathroom with a double sink vanity and a stand-up shower.

Half Bathroom #7: This half bath is conveniently located in the hallway on the right.

Laundry #1: A laundry room with a full-sized washer and dryer is located in the hallway on the right.

Garage/Carport: The garage is accessible to guests, featuring complimentary bikes and space for 1 vehicle to park. The covered carport can fit 3 additional vehicles.

2nd Floor:

Kitchen: When you get to the 2nd floor, take a left, and you’ll come right into this spacious kitchen. It comes fully stocked and equipped with all the standard amenities and appliances, plus some extras! It has a double oven, gas stove, large commercial fridge, 2 ice makers, and a wine and beverage cooler. The center island bar seats 8 people comfortably.

Dining Room: The dining room is across from the kitchen and behind the living room. It has a large wooden table that seats 10 people, with an elegant chandelier overhead.

Living Room: Straight past the kitchen, you will walk right into the living room. This cozy living space offers a leather sectional and accent seating for 6 people and features a large flat-screen TV. There is also access to the 2nd-floor balcony off the living room, which includes a dining table set for 6.

Bedroom + Bathroom #3: This bedroom is off the living room to the left. It includes a king-sized bed, 2 nightstands, a dresser, and a flat-screen TV. It has a private bathroom that is very luxurious, with a double sink vanity and a huge stand-up rainhead shower with a bench seat. This bedroom also has access to the balcony off the living room.

Bedroom + Bathroom #4: This bedroom is to the right and down the hall when you reach the 2nd-floor landing. It includes a king-sized bed, 2 nightstands, a dresser, and a flat-screen TV. It has a private bathroom with a double sink vanity and a stand-up shower. This bedroom also has access to its quaint balcony.

Bedroom + Bathroom #5: This is a fantastic custom-built bunk room! It includes 2 twin/twin bunk beds and a full/full bunk bed, sleeping 8 people. The bathroom that belongs to this room is very cleverly designed for many people. There are 2 separate sink rooms, and another separate bath and toilet room, so multiple people can be getting ready at the same time and still have privacy.

Half Bathroom #8: This half bathroom is conveniently located in the hallway on the right.

Laundry #2: This spacious laundry room features a full-sized washer and dryer, and generous storage space.

3rd Floor:

Game Room: The game room is designed for fun and friendly competition, featuring 2 arcade machines and a foosball table in a bright, open setting. Just steps away, direct access to the rooftop terrace makes it easy to move from indoor entertainment to outdoor relaxation.

Bedroom + Bathroom #6: If you go left, it will take you to the final bedroom. This bedroom includes a king-sized bed, 2 nightstands, a dresser, and a flat-screen TV. It also has a bathroom with a single-sink vanity. This bathroom can be private or used as a shared half bath for the people visiting the rooftop terrace.

Rooftop Terrace: Perched above the home, the rooftop terrace offers multiple spaces to relax and gather while taking in the scenic views. The open-air section features a firepit, hanging daybed, and hammock — perfect for sunset lounging and easy evenings under the sky. The covered, screened-in area extends the living space with comfortable lounge seating, a dining table, mounted TV, and a full summer kitchen complete with a built-in grill, sink, and refrigerator. A cornhole game adds a fun touch, making this level ideal for both entertaining and unwinding.

House Rules:
-This is a NON-smoking property.

Student Booking Policies:
-College student groups must all inquire and get approval before booking. Rates for student groups are subject to change; the price will be determined upon inquiry.
-If a college student group is accepted, they will be subject to a $100.00 fully refundable damage deposit per person.

Pets:
-This home is pet-friendly, up to 30lb in size, but all pets must be approved and are subject to a pet fee upon approval. Please request approval before booking.

Parking:
-All cars must be in the driveway. 4 cars maximum. No Trailers, RVs, Scooters, Boats, or Motorcycles are permitted per HOA rules.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
